latest_notice.synopsis: Intermittent overflows and spatter from both north and south vents occurred over the past day Halema'uma'u crater at the summit of Kīlauea. West vent had occasional glow overnight. There is no anomalous activity outside of the summit.

latest_activity_notice.synopsis: The Halemaʻumaʻu eruption of Kīlauea volcano is currently erupting small overflows from both the north and south vents. It is not possible to forecast the onset of episode 55 fountains or if they will occur.
